text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah! I lost!
The frustration is unreal!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, my mind's made up!
I'm gonna spread my wings even wider!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Once we totally master the runaway and rainbow sprints,
let's do it again! Deal?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
because I want to race together with you again too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hehe!
Well, thanks for today, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so glad
I got to run with you today, Helios-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
She was like that in the paddock too, but
she's so full of energy in the gate and during the race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I was the one getting energized.
What an incredible Umamusume she was.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Speak of the devil, here comes Helios-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "We're throwin' a 'Cheer Up Helios Fest' (a snack fest), wanna come too, Tannhauser!?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! I wanna go! "Count me iiiin!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but technically speaking,
I'm the one who won today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The 'Cheer Up Helios Fest' seemed to have been a blast, as Machikane Tannhauser had plenty of stories to share the next day.
